accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 3 and its supporting Theorems 1–2
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The band is conditional on exact low rank, independent centered sub-Gaussian cell errors on the joint analysis domain, rowwise variance structure, and the displayed primitive uniform remainder envelope.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Honest growing-horizon multiplier coverage holds under the complete-array class M^CY; it does not claim robustness to serial dependence, approximate rank, or data-selected tuning.

source_verification_receipts.version: JASA latest-article version, published online 20 September 2024
source_verification_receipts.locator: Publisher abstract and supplementary-material notice; primary text §3 and supplement G.2 are the cited locations
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article develops debiased inference for MNAR matrix completion under weak signals and supplies supplementary materials; the accessible article text identifies independent centered sub-Gaussian noise and a heteroskedastic extension in G.2.

source_verification_receipts.locator: §3, “Combining effects by calendar time vs event time” and “Heteroskedastic-robust inference,” paragraphs beginning at lines 45 and 51 of the public HTML rendering
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The discussion says event-time aggregation crosses calendar-time right factors so its normal approximation and variance may differ, and states that a staggered-adoption heteroskedastic variance estimator would be useful. It is public preprint/discussion text rather than a separately verified archival JASA theorem source.

The preprint provides prescribed-coverage confidence intervals for individual treatment effects and more general bilinear treatment-effect functionals under staggered adoption; the abstract does not claim a growing-dimensional simultaneous event-curve band.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Publisher abstract; feasible-CLT theorem described in the author-version record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies low-rank-completion inference without sample splitting and an average-treatment-effect application; its feasible CLT uses unit-specific variance structure for a fixed group-average functional.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Theorem 3, simultaneous-band corollary, and Algorithm 1 as corroborated by the public author manuscript
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper establishes a multiplier-bootstrap route to asymptotically valid simultaneous staggered-adoption inference under conditional parallel trends.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv primary preprint corresponding to Annals of Statistics 41 (2013), 2786–2819
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work proves Gaussian and conditional Gaussian-multiplier approximation for maxima of high-dimensional sums without restricting coordinate correlation.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv primary preprint corresponding to Annals of Applied Probability 33 (2023), 2374–2425
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work gives nearly optimal Gaussian and bootstrap approximation bounds for independent high-dimensional vector sums, but does not impose a low-rank staggered-panel construction.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: State an explicit admissible growth region for K in terms of the displayed leverage, replication, and Choi--Yuan block ratios, then verify that a nonempty balanced-factor sequence satisfies it.
Add a corollary comparing the simultaneous critical width with the scalar Xia--Yan--Wainwright interval and quantify the cost of shared-cell correlation relative to a diagonal approximation.
Develop a serially dependent or clustered-error extension with a valid covariance estimator, since independent state-year cells are restrictive for the stated RTC consumer.

recommended_next_step: Advance the conditional field-tier whole-curve band kernel to Stage 0; preserve the attainable-remainder question as open rather than treating the published envelope as sharp.
